text: 1次元Bratu：小さい枝のNewton–GMRES 1D Bratu: Newton–GMRES on the lower branch 1次元Bratu：小さい枝のNewton–GMRES u(x)=2 log[cosh(beta/2)/cosh(beta(x-1/2))], lambda=2 beta^2/cosh(beta/2)^2; beta=1 既存の残差十分減少による減衰NewtonとILU(0)付きGMRES。解析解u=2log[cosh(β/2)/cosh(β(x−1/2))]。βtanh(β/2)<2で小さい枝を選び、初期値は全点零。内部Newton制御は非線形許容値1e-10、最大30反復。 1D Bratu: Newton–GMRES on the lower branch u(x)=2 log[cosh(beta/2)/cosh(beta(x-1/2))], lambda=2 beta^2/cosh(beta/2)^2; beta=1 Existing residual-decrease damped Newton and ILU(0)-GMRES. Analytic u=2log[cosh(β/2)/cosh(β(x−1/2))]. βtanh(β/2)<2 selects the lower branch and all initial unknowns are zero. Nonlinear tolerance is 1e-10 with at most 30 Newton iterations. bratu-lower-branch-analytic 1次元Bratu：小さい枝のNewton–GMRES 1D Bratu: Newton–GMRES on the lower branch 厳密解・参照解 参照解 reference solution 解析解 Analytic reference
